summary: A modal window that pops up over the page and requires a response before you can continue.
description: MozDialog wraps the top-level <dialog> element used by XUL/HTML dialog windows and in-content subdialogs: renders the button box (accept/cancel/extra1/extra2/disclosure) and a content slot, wires Enter/Escape handling, default-button focus and snapping, and window sizing/positioning helpers.

attributes.name: subdialog
attributes.description: Observed attribute, set on the document root; switches the dialog into subdialog-embedded styling by appending the in-content stylesheet.

attributes.name: extra1-is-secondary
attributes.description: Observed attribute; on non-Windows Unix platforms, moves the extra1 button to appear after the cancel button.

attributes.name: buttons
attributes.description: get/set property. Comma-delimited list of dlgtype values (accept, cancel, extra1, extra2, disclosure) to show; any dlgtype not listed is hidden.

attributes.name: defaultButton
attributes.description: get/set property, defaults to "accept". Which button's command fires when Enter is pressed; toggles the default attribute on that button.

attributes.name: buttonlabel<dlgtype>
attributes.description: e.g. buttonlabelaccept, buttonlabelcancel, buttonlabelextra1, buttonlabelextra2, buttonlabeldisclosure. Per-button label override, read in _configureButtons(); falls back to dialog.properties localized defaults for accept/cancel/disclosure.

attributes.name: buttonaccesskey<dlgtype>
attributes.description: e.g. buttonaccesskeyaccept, buttonaccesskeycancel. Per-button accesskey override, paired with the corresponding buttonlabel<dlgtype> attribute.

attributes.name: buttonid<dlgtype>
attributes.description: e.g. buttonidaccept, buttonidcancel. Per-button Fluent id override, used via document.l10n.setAttributes() when no explicit label is set.

attributes.name: buttondisabledaccept
attributes.description: Inherited to [dlgtype='accept']: disabled state of the accept button.

attributes.name: buttonpack
attributes.description: Inherited to .dialog-button-box as pack, for platform-specific button layout.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Dialog body content, rendered via an <html:slot> inside the shadow DOM's .box-inherit[part=content-box].

events.name: dialogaccept
events.description: Cancelable Events-type event fired when the accept button (or Enter) is activated.

events.name: dialogcancel
events.description: Cancelable Events-type event fired when the cancel button (or Escape) is activated.

events.name: dialogextra1
events.description: Cancelable Events-type event fired when the extra1 button is activated.

events.name: dialogextra2
events.description: Cancelable Events-type event fired when the extra2 button is activated.

events.name: dialogdisclosure
events.description: Cancelable Events-type event fired when the disclosure button is activated.

events.name: dialogclosing
events.description: CustomEvent with detail { button }, fired immediately before window.close() on an uncanceled accept or cancel.

methods.name: acceptDialog
methods.description: Programmatically triggers the accept button's command.

methods.name: cancelDialog
methods.description: Programmatically triggers the cancel button's command.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: getButton(dlgtype): returns the button element for the given dlgtype.

methods.name: buttonBox
methods.description: Getter returning the shadow DOM's .dialog-button-box element.

methods.name: moveToAlertPosition
methods.description: Positions the dialog window relative to its opener, alert-style.

methods.name: centerWindowOnScreen
methods.description: Centers the dialog window on the screen.
